objections.text: The hand-derived fixed cases already test a lowercase province code joining 'US' under CI_AS and a province code with a trailing space joining 'US'. Additional mixed-case spellings and combining case with the trailing space attack the same two join mechanisms.

A08 duplicates the exact BusinessEntityAddress primary-key tuple (vendor 1, address 1, address type 2). It also sends AddressType names 'Shipping' and 'SHIPPING', which collide under the source case-insensitive unique key. The duplicate fan-out input is not valid source data.
